Sermons (transcripts)

1 John 2:8, 5 January 1946; Mark 1:9–15, 13 January 1946 (First Sunday after Epiphany); Romans 12:12, 19 January 1946; John 4:5–16 (conversation with the Samaritan woman), 20 January 1946; Luke 12:29, 26 January 1946; 2 Corinthians 4:6, 9 February 1946; Matthew 17:1–9, 10 February 1946 (Sexagesima); Jeremiah 9:17–24 (Septuagesima); Psalm 95:7f, 23 February 1946; Psalm 95:7f, 24 February 1946; 1 John 3:8, 9 March 1946; Isaiah 53:12, 13 April 1946; John 14:6, 14 April 1946 (confirmation); John 19:30, 19 April 1946 (Good Friday); 1 Corinthians 15:54–58 (Easter Monday); Isaiah 40:26–31, 12 May 1946 (Jubilate); Psalm 98, 19 May 1946 (Cantate); Luke 17:11–19, 22 May 1946 (school devotion); verses by Matthias Claudius, 26 May 1946; Hebrews 4:14–16, 30 May 1946 (Ascension Day); Luke 11:9–13 (Ask, and it will be given to you...), 2 June 1946 (Exaudi); Acts 2:14, 22–23, 37, 5 June 1946 (school service); Ezekiel 36:26ff, 8 June 1946 (Saturday before Pentecost); Romans 8:15, 10 June 1946 (Second Monday of Pentecost, confirmation); Matthew 11:28, 29 June 1946; Matthew 9:9, 30 June 1946 (Second Sunday after Trinity); John 15:16f, 6 July 1946 (Rosenberg–Wiedefeld wedding); Matthew 5:13–16, 14 July 1946 (Fourth Sunday after Trinity); Isaiah 43:1, 28 July 1946; Ephesians 5:9 (Walk as children of the light), 10 August 1946; Romans 8:12–17, 12 August 1946 (Eighth Sunday after Trinity); Luke 10:23–37 (the Good Samaritan), 15 September 1946 (dedication of the chapel at the Oberlinhaus); 1 Peter 5:7, 28 September 1946; Matthew 6:24–34 (Do not worry!), 29 September 1946; Luke 12:15–21 (the parable of the rich farmer), 7 October 1946 (Harvest Thanksgiving); Matthew 9:6 (Know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins), 26 October 1946; 2 Peter 3:3–14, 24 November 1946 (Sunday of the Dead); Matthew 21:1–9, 1 December 1946; Luke 21:25–36, 8 December 1946 (Second Sunday of Advent); Luke 1:46–55, 22 December 1946 (Fourth Sunday of Advent); John 3:16 (For God so loved the world...), 25 December 1946 (Christmas Day); Luke 2:15–20, 26 December 1946 (Second Day of Christmas); Luke 2:29f, 28 December 1946; Galatians 4:1–7, 29 December 1946.
